title: Platform Ops Lead
subtitle: Verified
summary: Lead Level 2 Technical Support and Level 3 SRE for the whole platform
Established the L1 → L2 → L3 support structure, processes and training
Technical lead on major incidents, releases and customer escalations
Mentor engineers across the organisation, including outside my own teams
details: I was promoted into a newly created Platform Ops Lead role, built around responsibilities I had already been carrying. I own both Level 2 Technical Support and Level 3 SRE, and helped establish the L1 → L2 → L3 structure that now underpins them — building T2 from scratch as a new function, including its documentation, processes, training and coding infrastructure. I run weekly planning and prioritisation across both teams and contribute to GDPR/DORA and wider operational decisions. I have stayed deliberately hands-on: leading the technical response to a week-long P2 platform degradation, owning production releases across every platform, and acting as the technical representative in customer meetings and escalations — including driving the TagD webhook incident end to end, from investigation through to remediation and customer communication. Across four years at Verified I have closed more than 1,200 tickets, over 1,000 of them incidents, and I am consistently the person other engineers come to for onboarding and difficult problems, whether or not they report to me.

title: SRE Consultant
subtitle: Verified
summary: Led disaster recovery exercises and ISO audit preparations
Rebuilt and owned the customer data deletion process end to end
Took over all SSO onboarding and improved system architecture
Built the shared automation tooling the platform teams now rely on
details: At Verified I played a key role in platform stability and operations. I led disaster recovery exercises aligned with ISO standards, handled major production incidents with root cause analysis and scripting to identify and repair affected data, and took over SSO integrations after a team transition, improving the architecture and onboarding major clients. I inherited an unfinished customer data deletion process, repaired it, cleared the historical backlog and moved the organisation onto a reliable monthly cadence, extending it for the largest customers. Much of my work was automation — mass deletion, data recovery, certificate operations, bulk modifications, production investigations and sensitive data cleanup — which I moved out of personal scripts and into a shared repository so the rest of the platform teams could use it too.
